summary.text: Public hospitals are organized in three levels (Decree 2-14-562, 2015): provincial and proximity hospitals (level 1), regional hospitals (level 2) and interregional university hospitals, the CHUs (level 3).
summary.quote: Articles 31-34: provincial/prefectural hospitals give first-level hospital care, regional hospitals second level, interregional hospitals (the CHUs) third level.

summary.text: The decree sets the emergency care each level must give: basic (UMHB) at provincial hospitals, complete (UMHC, with general intensive care, CT/MRI and SMUR transfer) at regional and interregional hospitals, specialized (UMHS) only at the CHUs. A standard is not proof a given hospital meets it.
summary.quote: LES URGENCES MEDICO-HOSPITALIERES COMPLETES (UMHC) Elles sont prodiguées au niveau des Hôpitaux Régionaux et Centres Hospitaliers interrégionaux. En plus des fonctions des UMHB, on trouve les 4 autres fonctions suivantes a ce niveau

summary.text: No trauma-centre designation (levels I-IV or equivalent) was found in the decree or on the Ministry's hospital list, so OSAP shows no official trauma level for Morocco and the plan's Tertiary role stays a gap.
